pages.title: FAQs
pages.text:
**Can I order online and choose pick up?**  
Absolutely! Pick up orders are exclusive to our Highland Park, Los Angeles location. Orders are typically ready to be picked up within about 15 minutes of being placed for orders made every day from 10-7pm. Outside of those hours we will have your order picked and packed as soon as possible on the following business day. You will receive an order confirmation email and then shortly thereafter an email letting you know the order is ready for pick-up.

**I saw a product on your website recently, but now I can't find it!**  
We do our best to keep our products in-stock at all times, but there will be times when products are temporarily unavailable. Check back to see if the item has become available again, or send us an email if you would like a notification when it is back in stock.

**I am part of the Card Enthusiasts Club. Can my online greeting card purchases count towards my free card?**  
Absolutely! During checkout, add a note letting us know you are part of the Card Enthusiasts Club and we will stamp your card appropriately. Please note: your free card is only redeemable in store.

**What is the Shorthand Card Enthusiasts Club?**  
Buy 10 greeting cards and get your 11th for free! Please note: your free card is only redeemable in store.

**I ordered an item, but I need it right away!**  
You are welcome to make your purchase online and then pick-up from our store in Highland Park, Los Angeles. You may also specify expedited shipping and we will do our best to ensure the products are mailed as quickly as possible.

**I placed an order a while ago and my order has not arrived yet. Where is it?**  
We do our best to ship orders as quickly and efficiently as possible. If it is taking longer for your order to arrive than you think it should, please contact us with your order number and we will do our best to help figure out where your order is and when you can expect to receive it.

**I have some ideas for products you should sell - can I tell you about them?**  
Sure thing! We love learning more about the kinds of products our customers are looking for and we love hunting to find them. Send us an email!

**I have some products that I design and / or manufacture that I think would be a great fit for your store. Can I show them to you?**  
We are always on the hunt for new products - please keep in mind that we are a small store with a very specific aesthetic and product offering. Please send us an email with more information about your products.

**Can I bring these products in to show you?**  
Our buyer is not always in the store so we discourage bringing products to the store. Please send us an email with more information about your products.
